findings: Read PDF independently first: two of three NEDs (Lee Shen Kai, Song Pengfei) are explicitly partner/VP of the GP/manager of identified Pre-IPO investors (Feitu Xinyuan; Broadband Chengbai). All 8 candidate quotes verified verbatim on the cited pdf pages with correct printed-page mapping (INDEX.tsv). Candidate correctly declined to count Wang Maike (Yuhuan Lupu Economic Development; no stated link to Yuhuan Investment) and Xiong Minghua (VC chair, not an investor in the company). Candidate correctly notes no 'nominated by' wording; classification rests on the officer/partner-of-GP/manager standard, which the reviewing standard accepts. Special rights (incl. corporate governance rights) lapse at Listing (pdf p114) but the seats persist at listing. Lee's earlier role at Shanghai Keke PE Fund Mgmt (GP chain of investor Shanghai Qingwang) ended June 2020 and was not relied on.
residual_uncertainty: Prospectus does not state that either NED was nominated by the investor; Lee joined the board (2015) before Feitu Xinyuan invested (2020). Song's link to Broadband Chengbai is two-step (via China Broadband Capital controlling Broadband Tianjin).
